sections.content: Ooga Booga is Berachain’s pioneering and native liquidity aggregator, designed to seamlessly and efficiently orchestrate swap executions. Our platform is dedicated to optimizing user journeys on our intuitive frontend while also serving as the preeminent facilitator for swap executions throughout external dApps.

sections.heading: Job Description
sections.content: We are in search of a Senior Frontend Engineer with a flair for designing exceptional user interfaces with crypto degens in mind. This crucial role centers on enhancing our platform's frontend capabilities to build the central pillar of trading on Berachain.

sections.heading: Responsibilities
sections.content:
Lead Development: Spearhead the creation and refinement of user-centric features, ensuring an intuitive and efficient interface on our crypto platform.
Responsive Design: Implement responsive design principles to guarantee optimal performance across various devices.
UI/UX Collaboration: Work closely with UI/UX teams to bring creative visuals to life, ensuring functional and engaging experiences that will leave degens craving.
Tech Innovation: Stay at the forefront of frontend technologies, integrating cutting-edge tools and practices to maintain our lead in the industry.
Cross-functional Teamwork: Partner with backend engineers to construct a solid, secure frontend framework, emphasizing scalability and security.
Performance Optimization: Enhance application performance, tackling technical hurdles to boost speed and scalability.
UI/UX Technical Feasibility: Validate the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs, refining concepts to achieve superior user experiences.
Feature Design and Vision: Actively participate in the ideation and execution of new features, from initial design to final release.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.content:
Professional Experience: 5+ years of frontend development experience, with a strong portfolio showcasing proficiency in crafting dynamic, responsive web applications. Should also have at least 2+ years working in the web3 space.
Technical Expertise:
Mastery of HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript + Typescript.
Proficient in React.js, Vue.js, or equivalent modern JS frameworks.
Experience with the latest EVM libraries (such as viem and wagmi) and smart contract interactions, demonstrating a solid understanding of blockchain technologies.
Confidence using UI libraries such as Tailwind and Shadcn or other industry-leading alternatives.
Familiarity with Web3 and blockchain development practices.
Skilled in using Git, CI/CD pipelines, and modern development tools.
Problem-Solving Skills: Excellent analytical abilities, capable of tackling complex problems and innovating solutions.
Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills, capable of collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
Adaptability: Quick learner, open to adopting new technologies and methodologies in a rapidly evolving environment.
Blockchain Passion: Genuine interest in cryptocurrencies, blockchain technology, and the DeFi ecosystem.

sections.heading: Preferred Qualifications
sections.content:
Certifications (Preferred): Certifications in modern frontend frameworks, blockchain technology, or UI/UX design.
Leadership Experience: Previous experience leading frontend projects or teams, especially in the crypto or fintech sectors.
Design Skills: A good eye for design and user experience, with the ability to work closely with design teams to implement UI/UX designs.
Trading Interface Development: Experience building sophisticated trading interfaces, including the implementation of real-time graphs and data visualization, to facilitate user interaction with market data.
Graphs and Data Visualization: Proficiency in implementing interactive graphs and data visualization tools, essential for displaying complex financial information in an accessible and user-friendly manner.
Integrating DEX Interfaces: Should have good understanding of prominent EVM-based DEXs such as Uniswap, Balancer etc.

If you are passionate about building on a chain based on weed smoking bears and possess the requisite expertise in frontend development and DeFi, we invite you to join us in shaping the future of the industry. Your innovative contributions will play a pivotal role in realizing our vision of a more inclusive and transparent financial ecosystem. Let's embark on this transformative journey together!
